dict.string: Records, transcribes and dictates entirely on your Mac.
github.com
TCP
Listen checks for new versions at launch and every six hours after.
You will not be told when a new version is released. Everything else keeps working.
*.apple-cloudkit.com
TCP

Syncing your library between your own devices, through your own iCloud account. Everything Listen puts there is sealed with a key that never leaves your devices, so Apple stores it and cannot read it.
Your devices stop seeing each other's recordings and notes. Nothing already on this Mac is lost or changed.
*.icloud.com
TCP
Reaching your iCloud account, and asking macOS whether you are signed into one.
The same as above: sync stops and everything local keeps working.
*.push.apple.com
TCP
How another of your devices tells this one that something changed. It carries no content of its own, only the fact that there is something to fetch.
Sync still works but only when Listen next looks, rather than within seconds of a change.
huggingface.co
TCP
Downloading the Parakeet speech model you selected, once, about 2.4 GB. No audio is ever uploaded.
The Parakeet engines cannot be downloaded. The Apple Intelligence engine needs no download and still works.
cdn-lfs.huggingface.co
TCP
The CDN that actually serves the model weights.
The model download stalls partway through.
eu.i.posthog.com
TCP

Anonymous usage statistics and crash reports, only if you opted in during setup or in Settings, Privacy. Counts and durations in rough buckets, under a random install ID, never recordings, transcripts, titles or names. TELEMETRY.md in the repository lists every event this can carry.
Nothing stops working. Listen behaves identically; the statistics simply do not arrive.
TCP

The OpenAI-compatible endpoint you set in Settings › Agent, if you set one. Only the meetings you ask about are sent, only at the moment you ask, and only when that endpoint is not on this Mac. There is no default and nothing is configured out of the box.
Questions put to a hosted endpoint fail. An endpoint running on this Mac, and Claude Code and Codex, are unaffected.
